SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH params AS (SELECT NULLIF($1, '')::uuid AS run_id, NULLIF($2, '')::uuid AS case_id, $3::boolean AS dry_run, $4::boolean AS restore_snapshot), target AS (SELECT c.* FROM cris_test_cases c, params p WHERE (p.run_id IS NOT NULL AND c.run_id = p.run_id) OR (p.case_id IS NOT NULL AND c.id = p.case_id)), conv_restore AS (UPDATE conversaciones cv SET estado = COALESCE(NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'conversation'->>'estado', '')::estado_conversacion, cv.estado), chatwoot_conv_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'conversation'->>'chatwoot_conv_id', '')::integer, cv.chatwoot_conv_id), chatwoot_contact_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'conversation'->>'chatwoot_contact_id', '')::integer, cv.chatwoot_contact_id), updated_at = now() FROM target t, params p WHERE p.dry_run = false AND p.restore_snapshot = true AND t.snapshot_before ? 'conversation' AND cv.id = NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'conversation'->>'id', '')::uuid RETURNING cv.id), mem_restore AS (UPDATE lead_memory lm SET conversation_state = COALESCE(NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'memory'->>'conversation_state', ''), lm.conversation_state), outbound_sequence_status = COALESCE(NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'memory'->>'outbound_sequence_status', ''), lm.outbound_sequence_status), customer_engaged = COALESCE(NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'memory'->>'customer_engaged', '')::boolean, lm.customer_engaged), selected_plan = NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'memory'->>'selected_plan', ''), selected_plan_name = NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'memory'->>'selected_plan_name', ''), selected_plan_price = NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'memory'->>'selected_plan_price', '')::numeric, selected_plan_duration = NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'memory'->>'selected_plan_duration', '')::integer, chatwoot_conv_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'memory'->>'chatwoot_conv_id', '')::integer, lm.chatwoot_conv_id), chatwoot_contact_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'memory'->>'chatwoot_contact_id', '')::integer, lm.chatwoot_contact_id), updated_at = now() FROM target t, params p WHERE p.dry_run = false AND p.restore_snapshot = true AND t.snapshot_before ? 'memory' AND lm.id = NULLIF(t.snapshot_before->'memory'->>'id', '')::uuid RETURNING lm.id), cancelled AS (UPDATE scheduled_followups sf SET status = 'CANCELLED', processed_at = now(), error_msg = 'cancelled_by_cris_qa_cleanup' FROM target t, params p WHERE p.dry_run = false AND sf.status = 'PENDING' AND sf.conversation_id = t.conversation_id RETURNING sf.id), case_update AS (UPDATE cris_test_cases c SET cleanup_status = CASE WHEN (SELECT dry_run FROM params) THEN 'DRY_RUN' WHEN (SELECT restore_snapshot FROM params) THEN 'RESTORED_FROM_SNAPSHOT' ELSE 'CLEANED_PENDING_FOLLOWUPS' END, updated_at = now() FROM target t WHERE c.id = t.id AND (SELECT dry_run FROM params) = false RETURNING c.id) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM target)::integer AS target_cases, (SELECT count(*) FROM conv_restore)::integer AS restored_conversations, (SELECT count(*) FROM mem_restore)::integer AS restored_memories, (SELECT count(*) FROM cancelled)::integer AS cancelled_followups, (SELECT count(*) FROM case_update)::integer AS updated_cases, (SELECT dry_run FROM params) AS dry_run, (SELECT restore_snapshot FROM params) AS restore_snapshot;

parameters.content:
## CRIS QA - Cleanup Restore

Webhook: POST /cris-qa-cleanup

Input: { run_id?, case_id?, dry_run=true, restore_snapshot=false }

Dry-run is default.
Set dry_run=false to cancel scoped pending followups.
Set restore_snapshot=true to restore selected conversation/memory fields from snapshot_before.
